title: View and Manage AP/AR Data OFF still lets a user create invoices and take payments if Invoicing & payments allows it
preconds: 1. A user has a role with Invoicing & payments View and Create & Edit, See Financial Data ON, and View and Manage AP/AR Data OFF.
steps:
1. Open a work order and create an invoice.
  2. Take a payment.
expected:
Both work.

Only the AP/AR-specific views (tabs, reports, sensitive fields) are hidden; invoicing still works.
